assets.scope: tempest-peak unique elemental/xorn (xorn.lua; rarity 50; five clones share the entry)

references.note: Approved disc, lighting and camera; do not copy its creature.
Native shape: a jagged fractured heap of brown earth-rock spikes, no limbs.
Shipped boney experiment (ivory spiky bone pile): the fragment must be opaque earth-rock with glowing cracks, not bone.

prompt_fields.subject: A compact upright cluster of jagged tan-ochre earth and rock shards, fractured apart: one central cracked spire with four broken splinters hovering just off its surface, a rough boulder-like lump at the base, and hairline glowing violet-lilac cracks running through the stone. Solid opaque rock with light-catching flat facets. No limbs, no head, no face.
prompt_fields.contrast: Siblings and lookalikes: Harkor'Zun himself (a huge horned four-armed humanoid, drawn separately), boney experiment (ivory bone spikes), crystal tokens (translucent white, red, crimson and violet crystals) and the sandworm-burrower sand heap. The fragment is a headless heap of splinters with a tall central spire (silhouette), opaque light tan-ochre rock with violet cracks (hue), clearly lighter than the darkest parts of the base.
prompt_fields.composition: One compact complete creature on a single circular tabletop disc, steep overhead three-quarter camera; visible clear neutral base ring on every side. Keep all anatomy and equipment well inside the inner four-fifths of disc radius. Base brightness must visually match reference neutral disc, with no illumination spill or ground effects. Disc plate discipline: measured results show generations of this style reference tend to render the disc DARKER than the reference, never lighter. So do not darken the disc at all: render the neutral disc -- including the whole outer-sixth ring band and the area under the creature -- at the style reference's own brightness, if anything a hair lighter, and never darker. No warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette anywhere on the disc. Do not darken the creature to compensate either. Add no warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette to the disc anywhere, including directly under or behind dark-bodied creatures.
prompt_fields.palette: Light tan-ochre and sandstone rock facets with slightly darker terracotta cracks and thin glowing violet-lilac fracture lines; never dark brown-black. Dry neutral charcoal disc with restrained copper-grey bevel, kept a visibly lighter value than the creature's darkest parts so the two never merge.
